encoding: little-endian signed Int32/Int64; network-order nonempty Guid16; strict UTF8 with Int32 byte lengths; presence/bool exactly 0/1; no trailing bytes; Int64 canonical decimal strings in TS
authority: ExpectedSiteScope is a request precondition. Actor/site/session derives from original authenticated server authority. coordination: Frame numbers and native error value remain unassigned until central owner coordination. Producer execution and generated/frozen frames/catalogs/fixtures/receipts remain held.
